description: This file is a PHP class definition for the 'Shipping' extension controller within the OpenCart admin extension namespace. It manages installing, uninstalling, and listing shipping extension modules, handling extension metadata, permissions, and dynamic controller loading.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping extensions in the OpenCart admin panel

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets the output response to the list of available shipping extensions

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles a list of available shipping extensions, their statuses, and actions for display in the admin interface

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a shipping extension, registering language files, permissions, and controllers

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a shipping extension, removing permissions and extension records
